q: In railway operations, 'IBH' stands for:
e: IBH in railway operations stands for Intermediate Block Halt, a block station between two regular block stations for operational purposes.

q: In railway traction, 'TSS' stands for:
e: TSS in railway traction stands for Traction Sub-Station, which steps down grid power to supply the overhead equipment for electric traction.

q: In railway signalling, 'SSI' stands for:
e: SSI in railway signalling stands for Solid State Interlocking, an electronic interlocking system replacing relay-based systems.

q: In railway signalling, 'BPAC' stands for:
e: BPAC in railway signalling stands for Block Proving by Axle Counters, which proves a block section is clear using axle counter track occupancy.

q: In railway traffic department, 'CPTM' stands for:
e: CPTM in railway traffic department stands for Chief Passenger Transportation Manager, the zonal officer in charge of passenger train operations.

q: In railway traffic department, 'CFTM' stands for:
e: CFTM in railway traffic department stands for Chief Freight Transportation Manager, the zonal officer in charge of freight train operations.

q: In railway coaching operations, the computerised system 'ICMS', used for monitoring train punctuality and coaching stock, stands for:
e: ICMS stands for Integrated Coaching Management System, the computerised system for monitoring train punctuality and coaching stock operations.

q: In railway operating statistics, 'EKM' stands for:
e: EKM in railway operating statistics stands for Engine Kilometre, the distance run by an engine, used as a unit of engine use.

q: In Indian Railways, 'MTRC' stands for:
e: MTRC in Indian Railways stands for Mobile Train Radio Communication, the radio system for communication between train crew and control.

q: In railway engineering department, 'PWI' stands for:
e: PWI in railway engineering stands for Permanent Way Inspector, the official responsible for inspection and maintenance of track, now broadly the section engineer cadre.

q: The Pune Metro underground section inaugurated in September 2024, whose opening marked the completion of Pune Metro Phase-1, runs from District Court to:
e: The Pune Metro underground section inaugurated in September 2024, completing Phase-1, runs from District Court to Swargate.

q: In January 2025, the foundation stone was laid for which new Delhi Metro corridor extending the Red Line into Haryana?
e: In January 2025, foundation stone was laid for the Rithala-Narela-Kundli corridor, the Delhi Metro Red Line extension into Haryana.

q: The new railway line approved by the Cabinet in October 2024 to provide rail connectivity to Amaravati, the capital of Andhra Pradesh, will run from Errupalem to:
e: The new railway line approved by the Cabinet in October 2024 to connect Amaravati will run from Errupalem to Namburu.

q: As announced in the Interim Budget 2024-25, how many normal rail bogies were proposed to be converted to Vande Bharat standards?
e: As announced in Interim Budget 2024-25, 40,000 normal rail bogies were proposed to be converted to Vande Bharat standards.

q: In January 2025, the Union Cabinet approved the setting up of which Central Pay Commission for Central Government employees, including railway employees?
e: In January 2025, the Union Cabinet approved setting up of the Eighth Central Pay Commission for Central Government employees, including railway employees.

q: The first driverless trainset for Chennai Metro Phase-II, delivered in October 2024, was manufactured by Alstom at its plant located at:
e: The first driverless trainset for Chennai Metro Phase-II, delivered in October 2024, was manufactured by Alstom at its Sri City plant in Andhra Pradesh.

q: The confirmatory trial run of the Vande Bharat Sleeper trainset conducted in January 2025 at 130 kmph was carried out between Ahmedabad and:
e: The confirmatory trial run of the Vande Bharat Sleeper at 130 kmph in January 2025 was carried out between Ahmedabad and Mumbai Central.

q: One of the ten Vande Bharat trains flagged off on 12 March 2024 connects Patna with which city of Uttar Pradesh?
e: One of the ten Vande Bharat trains flagged off on 12 March 2024 connects Patna with Lucknow, the capital of Uttar Pradesh.

q: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off in September 2024, the second 20-coach Vande Bharat train, connects Nagpur with:
e: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off in September 2024, the second 20-coach Vande Bharat, connects Nagpur with Secunderabad.

q: The RRB Group D (Level-1) recruitment notification CEN 08/2024, published in January 2025, advertised how many vacancies?
e: The RRB Group D Level-1 notification CEN 08/2024, published in January 2025, advertised 32,438 vacancies.

q: The Indian Port Rail and Ropeway Corporation Limited (IPRCL), the joint venture that provides rail evacuation systems to the major ports, was formerly known as:

options.B: Port Rail Corporation of India Limited
options.C: Indian Ports Rail Link Corporation Limited
options.D: Port and Rail Infrastructure Corporation Limited

e: The Indian Port Rail and Ropeway Corporation Limited was formerly known as Indian Port Rail Corporation Limited, before ropeway business was added to its name.

q: The headquarters (registered office) of the Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Limited (Maha Metro) is located in which city?
e: The headquarters and registered office of Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Limited (Maha Metro) is located in Nagpur.

q: The registered office of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) is located at:

options.A: Rail Bhawan, Raisina Road, New Delhi
options.B: Metro Bhawan, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi
options.C: Transport Bhawan, Parliament Street, New Delhi

e: The registered office of Delhi Metro Rail Corporation is at Metro Bhawan, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi.

q: The Ahmedabad-Rajkot semi-high-speed rail corridor project in Gujarat is being spearheaded by which State-level rail infrastructure body?
e: The Ahmedabad-Rajkot semi-high-speed rail corridor in Gujarat is being spearheaded by G-RIDE, the Gujarat Rail Infrastructure Development Corporation.

q: In Kochi Water Metro Limited (KWML), the special purpose vehicle set up for operating the Kochi Water Metro services, the majority equity of 74 per cent is held by the:
e: In Kochi Water Metro Limited, the majority equity of 74 percent is held by the Government of Kerala, with the balance held by Kochi Metro Rail Limited.

q: The 'Mallige' corridor of the Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project, being executed by K-RIDE, connects Baiyappanahalli with:
e: The Mallige corridor of Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project, executed by K-RIDE, connects Baiyappanahalli with Chikkabanavara.

q: Which of the following RRTS corridors is one of the three corridors prioritised for implementation in the first phase in the National Capital Region?
e: Delhi-Panipat is one of the three RRTS corridors prioritised in Phase-1 in the National Capital Region, along with Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut and Delhi-Gurugram-Alwar.

q: The Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) has been appointed as the Project Executing Agency (PEA) for the proposed metro rail project of which Tamil Nadu city?
e: Chennai Metro Rail Limited has been appointed Project Executing Agency for the proposed metro rail project of Coimbatore.

q: The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) has served as a consultant, as part of the general consultant consortium, for the metro rail project of which foreign capital city?
e: DMRC has served as consultant, as part of the general consultant consortium, for the metro rail project of Dhaka, the capital of Bangladesh.

q: The Seremban-Gemas Electrified Double Track Project, a turnkey project of about US$ 1 billion executed by IRCON International, is located in which country?
e: The Seremban-Gemas Electrified Double Track Project, a turnkey project of about US dollar 1 billion executed by IRCON International, is located in Malaysia.

q: The Mumbai Metro Line-2B, running from D. N. Nagar to Mandale, is being implemented by which authority?
e: Mumbai Metro Line-2B from D. N. Nagar to Mandale is being implemented by MMRDA, the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority.

q: CIDCO, the New Town Development Authority responsible for developing Navi Mumbai and the Navi Mumbai Metro, is a company wholly owned by the:
e: CIDCO, the New Town Development Authority for Navi Mumbai and the Navi Mumbai Metro, is a company wholly owned by the Government of Maharashtra.

q: The Delhi Metro Rail Academy (DMRA), the training institute of DMRC, is located at which Delhi Metro depot?
e: The Delhi Metro Rail Academy, DMRC's training institute, is located at the Shastri Park depot in Delhi.

q: The Jaipur Metro Rail Corporation Limited (JMRC) was incorporated in the year:
e: Jaipur Metro Rail Corporation Limited was incorporated on 1 January 2010 as a wholly owned company of the Government of Rajasthan.

q: The Electric Loco Shed at Howrah functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Electric Loco Shed at Howrah functions under Eastern Railway, whose headquarters is at Kolkata.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Golden Rock (Ponmalai) in Tiruchirappalli functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Golden Rock (Ponmalai) in Tiruchirappalli functions under Southern Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Shakurbasti in Delhi functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Shakurbasti in Delhi functions under Northern Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Bhagat Ki Kothi in Jodhpur functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Bhagat Ki Kothi in Jodhpur functions under North Western Railway, under whose Jodhpur division it falls.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Moula Ali in Hyderabad functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Moula Ali in Hyderabad functions under South Central Railway.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Miraj in Maharashtra functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Diesel Loco Shed at Miraj in Maharashtra functions under Central Railway, under whose Pune division Miraj falls.

q: In railway operations, the trackside equipment 'HABD', installed for detecting overheated axle boxes of passing trains, stands for:
e: HABD in railway operations stands for Hot Axle Box Detector, trackside equipment that detects overheated axle boxes of passing trains to prevent failures.

q: In railway signalling, 'RRI' stands for:
e: RRI in railway signalling stands for Route Relay Interlocking, a relay-based system that sets and locks routes through a station yard.

q: In railway block working, 'PLCT', the paper authority issued to a driver to enter a block section, stands for:
e: PLCT in railway block working stands for Paper Line Clear Ticket, the paper authority issued to a driver to enter a block section when normal instruments fail.

q: In railway signalling, 'CLS' stands for:
e: CLS in railway signalling stands for Colour Light Signalling, which uses coloured light aspects instead of semaphore arms to control trains.

q: In Indian Railways operating statistics, 'PKM', a measure of passenger traffic output, stands for:
e: PKM in Indian Railways operating statistics stands for Passenger Kilometre, the output measure of carrying one passenger over one kilometre.

q: In railway signalling, 'PI' stands for:
e: PI in railway signalling stands for Panel Interlocking, where routes are set from a control panel with relay interlocking logic.

q: The Phase-2 of the Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar Metro, inaugurated in September 2024, extended the metro's main line from Motera Stadium to which terminal station in Gandhinagar?
e: Phase-2 of Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar Metro, inaugurated on 16 September 2024, extended the main line from Motera Stadium to Sector-1 in Gandhinagar.

q: The Vande Bharat Express service flagged off on 31 August 2024 connected Meerut City with which city?
e: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off on 31 August 2024 connected Meerut City with Lucknow.

q: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off on 15 September 2024 at Tatanagar connected Deoghar with which city?
e: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off on 15 September 2024 at Tatanagar connected Deoghar with Varanasi.

q: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off on 16 September 2024 connected Pune with which Karnataka city?
e: The Vande Bharat Express flagged off on 16 September 2024 connected Pune with Hubballi in Karnataka.

q: The Ranchi-Varanasi Vande Bharat Express was among the ten Vande Bharat services flagged off on:
e: On 12 March 2024, the Prime Minister flagged off ten new Vande Bharat trains from Ahmedabad, and the Ranchi-Varanasi service was one of those ten routes.

q: Under the RRB NTPC (Graduate) Centralised Employment Notice CEN 05/2024, notified in September 2024, the number of vacancies advertised was:
e: CEN 05/2024 was the RRB NTPC (Graduate) notice of September 2024 and it advertised 8,113 graduate-level vacancies; the separate undergraduate notice covered the remaining posts of the combined NTPC recruitment.

q: Ashwini Vaishnaw assumed charge as the Minister of Railways for a second consecutive term on:
e: Ashwini Vaishnaw assumed charge as Minister of Railways for a second consecutive term on 11 June 2024, two days after the new Council of Ministers was sworn in on 9 June 2024.

q: The Anji Khad Bridge, India's first cable-stayed railway bridge, inaugurated in June 2025 as part of the USBRL project, is built across which river?
e: The Anji Khad Bridge, India's first cable-stayed railway bridge inaugurated in June 2025 under the USBRL project, spans the Anji River, a tributary of the Chenab, between Katra and Reasi.

q: Along with the inauguration of the New Pamban Bridge in April 2025, a new express train service was flagged off between Rameswaram and:
e: At the inauguration of the New Pamban Bridge in April 2025, the Prime Minister also flagged off the new Rameswaram-Tambaram express, Tambaram being the Chennai terminal named in the key.

q: The weekly express train flagged off on 22 May 2025 connected Bikaner with which Mumbai station?
e: The weekly express flagged off on 22 May 2025 from Deshnoke linked Bikaner with Bandra Terminus in Mumbai, giving Bikaner a direct train to Mumbai's western suburban terminal.

q: The Railway Protection Force drive 'Operation Satark' is primarily directed against:

options.A: Illegal transportation of liquor through trains
options.C: Theft of passenger belongings in trains

e: Operation Satark is the RPF drive against illegal transportation of liquor and other contraband through trains, under which illicit liquor consignments carried by rail are seized and offenders booked.

q: Among the three economic railway corridor programmes announced in the Interim Budget 2024-25, the programme for decongesting the high-traffic-density routes is named:
e: Of the three economic railway corridor programmes in the Interim Budget 2024-25, the high-traffic-density routes programme is called Amrit Chaturbhuj; Rail Sagar is the port connectivity corridor.

q: For the nationwide inauguration of 103 redeveloped Amrit Bharat stations in May 2025, the Prime Minister was personally present at which redeveloped station in Rajasthan?
e: For the nationwide inauguration of 103 redeveloped Amrit Bharat stations on 22 May 2025, the Prime Minister was personally present at Deshnoke station in Rajasthan, near Bikaner, after visiting the Karni Mata temple.

q: Which of the following multitracking projects was among the three railway projects approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs in November 2024?
e: The CCEA in November 2024 approved three multitracking projects - Jalgaon-Manmad fourth line, Bhusawal-Khandwa third and fourth lines, and Prayagraj-Manikpur third line - so Bhusawal-Khandwa was among them.

q: The Industrial Finance Corporation of India (IFCI), the first development financial institution set up in India to provide long-term finance to industry, was established in the year:
e: IFCI was established in 1948 as India's first development financial institution, set up to provide medium and long-term finance to industry.

q: The Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India Limited (ECGC), which provides export credit insurance to Indian exporters, functions under the administrative control of the:
e: ECGC Limited, which provides export credit insurance to Indian exporters, works under the administrative control of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

q: The National Housing Bank (NHB), the principal agency set up to promote and regulate housing finance institutions in India, was established in the year:
e: The National Housing Bank was established in 1988 under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987, as the principal agency to promote and regulate housing finance institutions.

q: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI), the regulator for insolvency and bankruptcy proceedings, was established in 2016 under which legislation?
e: The IBBI was established on 1 October 2016 under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, which is the legislation that creates and empowers this insolvency regulator.

q: The Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC), the apex-level body set up in 2010 to monitor macro-prudential supervision of the economy, is chaired by the:
e: The FSDC, set up in 2010 as the apex body for macro-prudential supervision and financial stability, is chaired by the Union Finance Minister.

q: The Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India Limited (SPMCIL), which operates the Government currency presses, security presses and mints, is a wholly owned company of the Government of India under the:
e: SPMCIL, which runs the government currency presses, security presses and mints, is a wholly owned Government of India company under the Ministry of Finance.

q: Which organisation is designated as the sole re-insurer in the Indian insurance market, providing reinsurance support to direct general and life insurers in India?

options.D: General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC Re)

e: General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC Re) is the designated sole Indian re-insurer, obliged to receive a statutory cession and providing reinsurance support to direct insurers in India.

q: The Agriculture Insurance Company of India Limited was incorporated in December 2002 primarily to implement which type of insurance business in India?
e: The Agriculture Insurance Company of India Limited was incorporated in December 2002 specifically to implement crop insurance and other agriculture-related insurance business.

q: The Housing and Urban Development Corporation Limited (HUDCO), which finances housing and urban infrastructure projects, was incorporated in the year:
e: HUDCO was incorporated in 1970 to finance housing and urban infrastructure projects, and it remains the Government's housing and urban development finance corporation.

q: The National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF), set up by the Government of India as a fund manager to invest in infrastructure and allied sectors, was set up in the year:
e: The National Investment and Infrastructure Fund was set up in 2015 as a Government-backed fund manager to channel investment into infrastructure and allied sectors.

q: The National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGTC) was set up by the Government of India in 2014 primarily to:

options.A: Print currency notes for the Reserve Bank of India
options.C: Insure bank deposits of small depositors
options.D: Manage and operate various credit guarantee funds

e: NCGTC was set up in 2014 to act as trustee and manage and operate various credit guarantee funds of the Government of India for loans such as MSME and education loans.

q: The National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC), which provides financial assistance for the economic empowerment of Scheduled Castes, works under the administrative control of the:

options.A: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

e: NSFDC, which gives concessional financial assistance for the economic empowerment of Scheduled Castes, functions under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

q: The headquarters of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), the multilateral development bank of which India is a founding member, is located at:
e: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), of which India is a founding member and second-largest shareholder, has its headquarters at Beijing, China.

q: The Wagon Repair Workshop at Badnera in Maharashtra, which undertakes body periodic overhaul of freight wagons, belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Wagon Repair Workshop at Badnera in Maharashtra, which does body periodic overhaul of freight wagons, is a Central Railway workshop under that zone.

q: The Carriage Repair Workshop at Bhavnagar Para in Gujarat, which undertakes periodic overhaul of broad gauge coaches, belongs to which zonal railway?
e: The Carriage Repair Workshop at Bhavnagar Para in Gujarat, which undertakes periodic overhaul of broad gauge coaches, belongs to Western Railway, as its workshop documents show.

q: The Guntur division of South Central Railway, which became fully operational on 1 April 2003, was created mainly by bifurcating which existing division?
e: Guntur division of South Central Railway became fully operational on 1 April 2003 and was created mainly by bifurcating the Vijayawada division.

q: The Ranchi division of South Eastern Railway was formed in April 2003 by reorganising which two existing divisions of the zone?
e: Ranchi division of South Eastern Railway was formed in April 2003 by reorganising the Adra and Chakradharpur divisions of the zone.

q: When the Pune division of Central Railway was formed in January 1996, its jurisdiction was initially limited to which section only?
e: When Pune division of Central Railway was formed in January 1996, it initially had jurisdiction over the Lonavala-Pune section only; Pune-Daund and Pune-Miraj sections were added later, in 2003.

q: The Hyderabad division of South Central Railway was created in February 1978 by bifurcating which existing division?
e: Hyderabad division of South Central Railway was created on 17 February 1978 by bifurcating the existing Secunderabad division.

q: In the Indian electronic payment system, 'NEFT' stands for:
e: NEFT stands for National Electronic Funds Transfer, the RBI-operated nationwide system for one-to-one electronic transfer of funds between bank accounts.

q: In income tax, 'TCS' stands for:
e: In income tax, TCS stands for Tax Collected at Source, the tax a seller collects from the buyer at the time of sale of specified goods or services.

q: In financial statements analysis, 'EBITDA' stands for:

options.A: Earnings Before Income Tax, Duties and Assessments
options.B: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortisation
options.C: Estimated Business Income Tax and Debt Adjustment
options.D: Earnings Before Interest, Tax and Dividend Appropriation

e: EBITDA stands for Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortisation, a measure of a company's operating performance before those charges.

q: In banking, a loan account classified as 'NPA' stands for:
e: In banking, NPA stands for Non-Performing Asset, a loan or advance on which interest or principal repayment has remained overdue for the prescribed period.

q: In financial markets and company accounts, 'EPS' stands for:
e: In financial markets and company accounts, EPS stands for Earnings Per Share, the portion of a company's profit attributable to each outstanding equity share.

q: In Indian banking, the 11-character code 'IFSC', printed on cheque leaves and used for electronic fund transfers, stands for:
e: IFSC stands for Indian Financial System Code, the 11-character alphanumeric code that identifies each bank branch participating in electronic fund transfer systems.

q: The Amrit Bharat Express launched on 28 April 2026 connects Banaras in Uttar Pradesh with Hadapsar, which is located near which city in Maharashtra?
e: The Amrit Bharat Express launched on 28 April 2026 runs between Banaras and Hadapsar, and Hadapsar is a station in Pune, Maharashtra, so the city asked for is Pune.

q: The Vande Bharat Express service which earlier ran between Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra and Srinagar was extended in April 2026, providing the first direct passenger train between Srinagar and which station?
e: In April 2026 the Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra-Srinagar Vande Bharat was extended to Jammu Tawi, flagged off on 30 April 2026, creating the first direct passenger train between Srinagar and Jammu Tawi.

q: Which of the following multi-tracking projects was among the three railway projects approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs in May 2026?
e: Among the three multitracking projects approved by the CCEA in May 2026 were the Nagda-Mathura third and fourth lines, along with Guntakal-Wadi and Burhwal-Sitapur, at a total cost of about Rs 23,437 crore.

q: The Ahmedabad (Sarkhej)-Dholera railway project, approved by the Union Cabinet in May 2026, is notable as the first project of Indian Railways of which type?
e: The Ahmedabad (Sarkhej)-Dholera project approved in May 2026, a 134 km double line designed for 220 kmph, was described by the Railways as Indian Railways' first semi high-speed rail project, using indigenously developed technology.

q: The breakthrough of the mountain tunnel MT-07 of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train Project, achieved in June 2026 at Ambesari village, took place in which district of Maharashtra?
e: The breakthrough of mountain tunnel MT-07 of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train Project was achieved on 1 June 2026 at Ambesari village in Dahanu taluka of Palghar district, Maharashtra.

q: How many redeveloped railway stations under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme were inaugurated by the Prime Minister on 17 July 2026?
e: On 17 July 2026 the Prime Minister inaugurated 75 redeveloped stations under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme, across 20 states at a cost of about Rs 1,570 crore, the second such tranche after 103 stations in May 2025.

q: Which of the following railway projects was among the three multi-tracking projects approved by the Union Cabinet in September 2026?
e: Among the three multitracking projects approved by the Union Cabinet on 9 September 2026 was the Kharagpur-Jharsuguda (Bagdehi) fourth line, along with Katni-Pendra Road fourth line and Bilaspur-Pendra Road third line.

q: The Kavach automatic train protection system, commissioned in September 2026 on the Agra Cantt-Dholpur section, has been installed on a section forming part of which high-density route?
e: The Kavach system commissioned in September 2026 on the 52.5 km Agra Cantt-Dholpur section extends the automatic train protection cover on the high-density Delhi-Mumbai route, of which this section forms a part.

q: As announced by the Railway Minister in September 2026, the existing Madgaon-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Express will be extended up to which city?
e: As announced by the Railway Minister in September 2026, the existing Madgaon-Mangaluru Vande Bharat Express will be extended up to Bengaluru, running as the Yesvantpur-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat.

q: The new daily train service flagged off on 3 September 2026 connects Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Mumbai, with which station in the Konkan region?
e: The new daily train flagged off on 3 September 2026 links Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Mumbai, with Sawantwadi Road in the Konkan region, covering about 510 km via Kudal and Kankavli.

q: The first operational stretch of Chennai Metro Rail Phase-2, inaugurated on 11 October 2026, connects Poonamallee Bypass with which station?
e: The first operational stretch of Chennai Metro Rail Phase-2, inaugurated on 11 October 2026, is the Corridor 4 stretch from Poonamallee Bypass to Vadapalani, about 15 km with 11 elevated stations.

q: The new Karaikal-Peralam railway line, dedicated to the nation in October 2026, provides direct rail connectivity to which port?
e: The new 23 km Karaikal-Peralam railway line, dedicated to the nation on 11 October 2026, provides direct rail connectivity to Karaikal Port, improving freight movement of coal, fertilisers and food grains.

q: With the inauguration of the Tadoki-Raoghat railway line in October 2026, a train reached Raoghat for the first time since Independence. Raoghat is located in which State?
e: With the inauguration of the Tadoki-Raoghat section on 20 October 2026, a train reached Raoghat for the first time since Independence; Raoghat lies in the Bastar region of Chhattisgarh.

q: The New Delhi-Patna Vande Bharat Festival Special train, introduced in October 2026 to clear the festive rush, runs between New Delhi and Patna via which major station?
e: The New Delhi-Patna Vande Bharat Festival Special introduced in October 2026 to clear the festive rush is routed via Prayagraj Junction, as per the Northern Railway announcement of the service.

q: In January 2026, the Kathua railway station in Jammu and Kashmir was officially renamed in honour of which Kirti Chakra awardee martyr?
e: In January 2026 Kathua railway station was renamed as Martyr Captain Sunil Kumar Choudhary Kathua Railway Station, honouring the Kirti Chakra (posthumous) awardee of 7/11 Gorkha Rifles who was martyred fighting ULFA militants in Assam in 2008.
